android.desc:
View artworks curated by museums from around the world with the Google Arts & Culture VR app. Step inside a virtual gallery to see works by artists like Van Gogh or Rembrandt. You can zoom in to see every brushstroke, and hear audio guides from expert museum curators.

The Google Arts & Culture VR app requires a Daydream-ready headset such as Daydream View and a Daydream-ready phone such as Pixel. Learn more at http://g.co/daydream.

Use of this application is governed by the Google Terms of Service (https://google.com/accounts/TOS) and Privacy Policy (https://google.com/policies/privacy/). This app will be removed on 16 August.

quotes.text:
I think this is what you're looking for (though you'll need to find some discontinued hardware to run it I think):
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.vr.museums&hl=en_US
quotes.story_title: Free virtual tours of 2,500 museums around the world

quotes.text:
Street View has 2,362 museums (including this one) which you can look at with a vive, oculus or daydream. Or do you want 3D scans?

https://artsandculture.google.com/theme/igKSKBBnEBSGKg

https://artsandculture.google.com/search/streetview?project=streetviews

https://artsandculture.google.com/partner/van-gogh-museum

https://artsandculture.google.com/partner/palace-of-versailles look at the https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hall_of_Mirrors

There's a Daydream app for looking at paintings scanned by Google https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.vr.museums. You'll need the $100 headset and a Pixel or some other compatible phone.

Google's collection is large but nowhere near exhaustive. I think some paintings are over 100,000 pixels across. In my opinion virtual reality doesn't add much. It's blurry. If you have a good monitor the website is better

https://artsandculture.google.com/favorite/group/fAKyrWQ7SlXcJg

Wikimedia Commons has hundreds of scans for some artists

https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Paintings_by_artist
quotes.story_title: Nearly 1,000 Paintings and Drawings by Vincent van Gogh Digitized and Put Online
